svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drawn as printed: flange on the bed, core pointing up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Flange 194.6 mm across, 5 mm thick, with a skirt 6 mm deep and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3 mm thick round its edge (188.6 mm inside): the skirt slides

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: over the silicone block and centres the core in the cavity.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Core: a cone 142 mm across at the flange, 96 mm across at the tip,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 18 mm long. It forms the inside of the dome.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four 4 mm overflow holes on a 146 mm circle, at 45 degrees to

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each other: spare resin and air come out here.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Sand the core smooth and spray mould release before each cast.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: flange flat on the top of the silicone block; the gap between

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the core and the cavity is the 4 mm dome wall at the crown.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: on a trial fit with no resin the flange sits flat all round.
